tools.name: genomeblocks
tools.data_model: columnar tables (numpy columns; the row is the join key) with swappable backends
tools.notes: Columnar tables for peaks, genes, signal, motifs, enrichment, loops / contact graphs and RNA-seq in one API; de testing is planned for 2.1.

tools.name: 3D-GNOME
tools.data_model: ChIA-PET/Hi-C interaction-driven 3D polymer modelling with SV-aware remodelling
tools.notes: Adjacent (3D modelling); 2.0 in NAR 2020 (10.1093/nar/gkaa388); 3dgnome.cent.uw.edu.pl refused connections 2026-10-22.

tools.name: Activity-by-Contact (ABC)
tools.data_model: Snakemake workflow: candidate elements x activity x Hi-C contact (.hic/bedpe or power-law) -> enhancer-gene ABC scores
tools.notes: hub_mining marked as adjacent (E-G scoring, not graph hubs); last commit 2026-08.

tools.name: AGAT
tools.data_model: OMNISCIENT in-memory GFF/GTF hash with automatic format fixing; ~80 agat_* scripts
tools.notes: Annotation-file sanitiser/converter (gff2bed, gxf2gxf, add_introns, manage_UTRs, extract_sequences, statistics); no region annotation; README says the paper is not yet published.

tools.name: AIList
tools.data_model: sorted sublists augmented with running max-end
tools.notes: Reference C implementation + CLI from the Sheffield lab; last push 2022; the Python 'ailist' package below is an independent reimplementation.

tools.name: ailist (Python)
tools.data_model: AIList in Cython/C over numpy arrays
tools.notes: Single-chromosome AIList with intersect/subtract/common/merge/coverage/wps; numpy in, pandas Series out; no nearest.

tools.name: annotatr
tools.data_model: GRanges of regions x GRanges of built-in/custom annotations (overlap join)
tools.notes: Overlap-based multi-label annotation (promoters/5'UTR/exons/introns/3'UTR/intergenic, CpG, enhancers, chromatin states, MANE/canonical) with plot_annotation/plot_coannotations; no distance-to-TSS; promoters fixed at 1 kb unless built via build_txdb_annotations.

tools.name: apeglm
tools.data_model: shrinkage estimator plugged into DESeq2::lfcShrink
tools.notes: Approximate posterior estimation for GLM coefficients (heavy-tailed prior); default shrinker for DESeq2 and the model PyDESeq2 re-implements.

tools.name: ArchR
tools.data_model: ArchRProject peakSet GRanges with metadata from geneAnnotation (TxDb/OrgDb)
tools.notes: Single-cell ATAC framework; peaks get nearestGene/distToGeneStart/peakType (Promoter/Exonic/Intronic/Distal)/distToTSS/nearestTSS/GC with promoterRegion user-set; GitHub-only install; last push 2025-02; Single-cell framework; hypergeometric motif enrichment in marker peaks; last GitHub push 2025-02.

tools.name: ashr
tools.data_model: effect estimates + standard errors
tools.notes: Empirical-Bayes adaptive shrinkage used by DESeq2::lfcShrink(type='ashr'); CRAN release 2023-08, GitHub commits to 2026-05.

tools.name: bamsignals
tools.data_model: BAM -> count vectors / profile matrices (C++)
tools.notes: bamProfile / bamCount / bamCoverage straight from indexed BAM, strand-specific; no plotting; GitHub push 2026-05.

tools.name: BART2
tools.data_model: query regions mapped onto a union-DHS universe, scored against ~7k prebuilt TF ChIP-seq profiles (Wilcoxon/Irwin-Hall ranking)
tools.notes: Requires multi-GB prebuilt library download; the bioconda package 'bart' is an unrelated tool; last commit 2026-03.

tools.name: baySeq
tools.data_model: countData S4
tools.notes: Empirical-Bayes posterior likelihoods of DE patterns across groups; snow-cluster parallelism; getLibsizes offers quantile/edgeR scaling.

tools.name: BCBio.GFF
tools.data_model: GFF3/GTF -> Biopython SeqRecord/SeqFeature hierarchy
tools.notes: Biopython-ecosystem GFF reader/writer (GFF.parse/GFF.write); no tables, no coordinates ops; lives inside the bcbb monorepo.

tools.name: BEDOPS
tools.data_model: streamed sorted BED text; set algebra across N files
tools.notes: First-class union/difference/symmetric-difference (-u/-d/-s) over any number of sorted files; sort-bed --max-mem for out-of-core; gtf2bed/gff2bed converters; last push 2025-04.

tools.name: bedr
tools.data_model: region strings / data.frames passed to external bedtools, BEDOPS, tabix binaries

first_published.venue: Source Code for Biology and Medicine

tools.notes: Thin R wrapper that shells out to bedtools/BEDOPS/tabix (must be installed); jaccard/reldist wrappers; low activity apart from CRAN maintenance.

tools.name: Bedshift
tools.data_model: BED perturbation (shift/add/cut/merge/drop) to build null/benchmark region sets
tools.notes: Null-set generator, not a test; repository archived 2026-03 and functionality folded into geniml.

tools.name: bedtk
tools.data_model: one BED loaded into cgranges, the other streamed
tools.notes: Minimal, very fast subset of bedtools (isec, flt, cov, sort, merge); README warns the CLI may change; no sorting required; Engine only (fast overlap), no statistics; v1.2 tagged 2025-08-24, just before the activity window.

tools.name: bedtools
tools.data_model: streamed text records (BED/GFF/VCF/BAM), one file at a time
tools.notes: Reference CLI for genome arithmetic; set ops limited to subtract/complement (union = cat|sort|merge); 'closest' against a TSS BED is the annotation use; last tagged release 2023 but repo pushed 2026-06; genomecov -bg -scale is the classic BAM->bedGraph route; GitHub push 2026-06 but no release since 2023-11; pybedtools wraps it; Primitives only: fisher (2x2 on one pair), jaccard, reldist, shuffle (-incl/-excl backgrounds) and pairtobed -type either/both for loop anchors; collection ranking must be scripted.

tools.name: bigwig-loader
tools.data_model: collection of bigWigs -> batched (batch x window x track) tensors on GPU
tools.notes: GPU (CUDA) bigWig decompression for ML dataloading; the only GPU region-cube reader found; conda-forge availability not verified.

tools.name: biobear
tools.data_model: Arrow record batches from Rust (Exon/DataFusion) readers; SQL sessions; to polars/pandas/duckdb
tools.notes: File-format-to-Arrow/SQL reader (BED, GFF, VCF, BAM, FASTA...) rather than an interval engine; overlaps only via SQL joins; repo quiet since 2025-03.

tools.name: BiocPy genomicranges / iranges
tools.data_model: GenomicRanges object: numpy/BiocFrame columns (seqnames, IRanges starts/widths, strand, mcols)
tools.notes: Genentech's port of the Bioconductor API (intra/inter-range, set ops, tiles, coverage, find_overlaps/nearest, promoters); read_gtf/read_ucsc; from_pandas/from_polars; BioC2023 abstract, no paper.

tools.name: BiocPy summarizedexperiment
tools.data_model: SummarizedExperiment / RangedSummarizedExperiment in Python
tools.notes: Python port of the Bioconductor container (BiocPy; 2023 BioC conference abstract, no journal paper found); converts to/from AnnData; pytximport can emit it.

tools.name: bioframe
tools.data_model: pandas DataFrames with chrom/start/end columns (no custom class)
tools.notes: Pure-pandas ops (overlap/closest/cluster/merge/complement/subtract/setdiff/coverage/expand/binnify); getfasta via load_fasta (pysam) + frac_gc; no union op, no index, single-threaded.

tools.name: bioinfokit
tools.data_model: pandas DataFrame
tools.notes: General toolkit with CPM/RPKM/TPM helpers and volcano/MA plots; no DE model; last commit 2024-05.

tools.name: Biopython
tools.data_model: Motif objects with counts/PWM/PSSM; PSSM.search over Seq
tools.notes: Broadest format parser (jaspar, meme, transfac, pfm, sites, xms, clusterbuster...); ScoreDistribution gives FPR/patser thresholds; logo via the WebLogo web service; pure-Python scanning is slow.

tools.name: Biopython GenomeDiagram
tools.data_model: SeqRecord features -> ReportLab linear/circular diagram
tools.notes: Feature maps (linear/circular) with cross-links from GenBank records; graph tracks from arbitrary data; no NGS file readers.

tools.name: Biostrings
tools.data_model: DNAStringSet / XStringViews
tools.notes: matchPWM / countPWM: one PWM against one sequence at an absolute score; the primitive under motifmatchr and TFBSTools.

tools.name: bwtool
tools.data_model: bigWig -> text matrix / summary / aggregate tables
tools.notes: matrix / aggregate / summary subcommands output numbers only (no plots); last commit 2017-09; used as the engine by trackplot.

tools.name: bx-python
tools.data_model: Cython IntervalTree/Intersecter, binned bitsets, 2bit/bigWig readers
tools.notes: Galaxy-era toolbox (IntervalTree.before/after/upstream_of_interval, binned bitsets, bed_* scripts, 2bit/bigWig access); still released but mostly maintenance.

tools.name: C3D
tools.aka: Cross Cell-type Correlation in DNaseI hypersensitivity
tools.data_model: anchor BED x open-chromatin signal matrix -> correlation-predicted interactions with p/q values and arc PDFs
tools.notes: Predicts interactions from accessibility correlation (bash + R); last commit 2018-08.

tools.name: cgranges
tools.data_model: implicit augmented interval tree stored as a sorted array
tools.notes: Heng Li's overlap-query library (C API + IITree.h); in-repo Cython wrapper but no PyPI package; underlies bedtk; last push 2024-05, no tagged releases.

tools.name: CHiCAGO
tools.data_model: Capture Hi-C bait-fragment counts -> convolution background -> significant interactions; WashU/interBed export
tools.notes: Capture Hi-C specific; Bitbucket activity not checked.

tools.name: ChIP-Atlas Enrichment Analysis
tools.data_model: web DB of public ChIP/ATAC/Bisulfite-seq peak sets; per-experiment 2x2 test vs permuted or user background
tools.notes: Background = random permutation of the query (x1/x10/x100) or a user BED; filters by experiment type and cell-type class; separate Colocalization tool gives antigen x antigen partners (TSV/GML); 2022 NAR update 10.1093/nar/gkac199; Fisher test per the paper (page does not name it).

tools.name: chipenrich
tools.data_model: peaks assigned to genes by locus definitions (nearest_tss, nearest_gene, 1/5/10 kb, exon, intron, enhancer, custom)
tools.notes: Gene-set enrichment with length/mappability correction (chipenrich, polyenrich, broadenrich, hybridenrich, proxReg); 10 genomes via chipenrich.data; plot_dist_to_tss; repo last pushed 2025-06.

tools.name: ChIPpeakAnno
tools.data_model: GRanges annotated against annoGR built from TxDb/EnsDb
tools.notes: annotatePeakInBatch (nearest TSS/gene, bindingRegion windows), assignChromosomeRegion / genomicElementDistribution pies, getEnrichedGO/PATH, binOverFeature; toGRanges reads BED/GFF/narrowPeak and TxDb/EnsDb.

tools.name: ChIPseeker
tools.data_model: csAnno object from annotatePeak(GRanges, TxDb)
tools.notes: Most-cited R peak annotator: tssRegion-configurable promoter class, plotAnnoPie/Bar, plotDistToTSS, covplot, seq2gene + clusterProfiler enrichment; GTF must first become a TxDb (txdbmaker); 2022 Current Protocols update (10.1002/cpz1.585); Profiles/heatmaps are of peak occupancy (optionally weighted), not of bigWig signal; primarily a peak annotator; Adjacent: covplot draws genome-wide peak coverage per chromosome and TSS profiles; peak annotation, not a locus track viewer.

tools.name: chromosight
tools.data_model: kernel-based pattern (loop/border/hairpin) detection and quantification on cool matrices
tools.notes: quantify scores user BED2D/BEDPE loops; last commit 2026-09, last release 2022-10.

tools.name: chromVAR
tools.data_model: peaks x cells counts + motif matches -> bias-corrected deviation z-scores
tools.notes: GC/accessibility-matched background peak sets; scanning via motifmatchr; the single-cell accessibility standard reused by ArchR/Signac.

tools.name: Cicero
tools.data_model: scATAC co-accessibility (graphical lasso) -> connections -> CCAN modules (Louvain) and gene activity
tools.notes: Not 3C data: edges are co-accessibility, communities via igraph; last commit 2026-03.

tools.name: Circos
tools.data_model: karyotype + data/link files + config
tools.notes: Adjacent circular ideogram/link plots (contacts as ribbons = a network-like view); upstream release date not verified (circos.ca TLS failure), bioconda package updated 2025-04.

tools.name: Cistrome DB Toolkit
tools.data_model: GIGGLE index over Cistrome DB ChIP-seq/DNase peak sets
tools.notes: dbtoolkit.cistrome.org reachable 2026-10-22; peak-set mode capped at 50,000 peaks; GIGGLE scoring per the 2019 NAR paper (page itself does not state method).

tools.name: Cistrome-GO
tools.data_model: peak BED (+ optional DE table) -> regulatory potential -> GO/KEGG enrichment
tools.notes: Adjacent (annotation theme): functional enrichment of one peak set, not co-occupancy against a track collection.

tools.name: cLoops2
tools.data_model: PETs (BEDPE/.pairs; HiC-Pro/Juicer via converters) -> cDBs -> peaks/loops/domains; anaLoops builds enhancer-promoter networks (HITS hubs)
tools.notes: Closest end-to-end analogue of a loop->graph->hub workflow (networkx, HITS, .sif export, closest-TSS anchor classes); cLoops (2020, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btz651) is the predecessor; last commit 2025-06.

tools.name: coitrees
tools.data_model: static van Emde Boas-layout interval tree in contiguous memory (SIMD variants)
tools.notes: Overlap-query engine used by polars-bio and granges; bed-intersect example binary; no Python binding.

tools.name: Coloc-stats
tools.data_model: HyperBrowser front-end unifying GenometriCorr, IntervalStats, LOLA, GIGGLE and HyperBrowser tests
tools.notes: Page returned only a title on 2026-10-22 (JS app); method list from the 2018 paper.

tools.name: ColoWeb
tools.data_model: query BED vs prebuilt feature DB with colocation measures and plots
tools.notes: Host projects.insilico.us.com no longer resolves (2026-10-22); historical entry.

tools.name: conorm
tools.data_model: pandas DataFrame
tools.notes: Small TMM / MRN (median-of-ratios) / GeTMM normaliser; no license metadata, dormant since 2021.

tools.name: CoolBox
tools.data_model: Frame of composable Track objects (operator syntax)
tools.notes: pyGenomeTracks-derived, Jupyter-first: Frame + Track composition with an interactive widget browser; .cool/.hic, arcs, BAM, bigWig, GTF.

tools.name: cooler
tools.data_model: HDF5 .cool/.mcool sparse contact matrices; cload bins pairs/pairix/tabix streams
tools.notes: Reference .cool format; ICE balancing (no o/e, that is cooltools); last commit 2026-01.

tools.name: coolpup.py
tools.data_model: pile-ups of cool matrices at BED/BEDPE features with expected normalisation
tools.notes: Last commit 2024-10.

tools.name: cooltools
tools.data_model: analysis on cooler matrices: expected, saddles, insulation, dots (loops), pileups
tools.notes: expected-cis + obs/exp, dots (HiCCUPS-style) loop caller; last commit 2025-07, just before the window.

tools.name: CoverageView
tools.data_model: CoverageBamFile / CoverageBigWigFile -> cov.matrix -> profile/heatmap
tools.notes: Small single-track package; activity is the Bioconductor version bump only (no public GitHub).

tools.name: CREAM
tools.aka: Clustering of genomic REgions Analysis Method
tools.data_model: peak BED -> clusters of cis-regulatory elements (COREs)
tools.notes: Peak-only alternative to ROSE (no signal ranking, data-driven stitching window); last commit 2021-02.

tools.name: csaw
tools.data_model: BAM -> window/region count matrices (SummarizedExperiment) + edgeR normalisation
tools.notes: TMM / efficiency / composition normalisation factors between samples; profileSites gives aggregate coverage profiles.

tools.name: data.table
tools.data_model: keyed data.table columns; generic overlap join
tools.notes: General-purpose table library; foverlaps() is a single overlap-join primitive, not a genomics toolkit; data.table itself is OpenMP-parallel but foverlaps parallelism is unverified.

tools.name: dcHiC
tools.data_model: compartment (PC) calling and differential compartments across .hic/.cool-derived matrices
tools.notes: Adjacent (compartments); last commit 2024-01.

tools.name: dearseq
tools.data_model: expression matrix + design
tools.notes: Variance-component score / permutation tests for gene and gene-set DE (robust to small n and longitudinal designs).

tools.name: DEBrowser
tools.data_model: Shiny app over count matrix
tools.notes: Interactive DESeq2/edgeR/limma front end with ComBat; active only via Bioconductor version bumps (upstream last commit 2024-02).

tools.name: decoupler
tools.data_model: AnnData / pandas
tools.notes: Adjacent: TF/pathway enrichment; ships a pseudobulk helper and an edgeR filter_by_expr port, DE itself is delegated to PyDESeq2 in its tutorials.

tools.name: deepTools
tools.aka: computeMatrix / plotHeatmap / plotProfile / multiBigwigSummary / bamCoverage / bigwigCompare
tools.data_model: bigWig/BAM -> gzipped matrix file -> plots; Python API modules
tools.notes: De-facto standard; reference-point and scale-regions matrices, --scaleFactor / bigwigCompare for between-track scaling; 4.0.0 requires Python>=3.12.

tools.name: DEGseq
tools.data_model: count matrix
tools.notes: Legacy MA-plot based tests (Fisher/LRT) without a replicate dispersion model; kept alive by Bioconductor version bumps.

tools.name: Degust
tools.data_model: web app (JS) over an R backend
tools.notes: Monash web tool running edgeR QL / limma-voom with interactive MA/parallel-coordinate views; commits to 2026-05 but no tagged release since 2019.

tools.name: DESeq (legacy)
tools.data_model: CountDataSet
tools.notes: Origin of median-of-ratios size factors; deprecated and removed from Bioconductor after release 3.12 (last version 1.42.0), superseded by DESeq2.

tools.name: DESeq2
tools.data_model: DESeqDataSet (SummarizedExperiment)
tools.notes: Median-of-ratios size factors, NB GLM Wald/LRT, lfcShrink (apeglm/ashr/normal), vst/rlog; DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount reads htseq-count files, salmon/kallisto come in via tximport; BiocParallel.

tools.name: DiffBind
tools.data_model: DBA object: peaks x samples counts from BAM, normalised affinity matrix
tools.notes: dba.normalize: library-size, RLE, TMM, spike-in, background bins; dba.plotProfile delegates matrices/heatmaps to profileplyr.

tools.name: diffHic
tools.data_model: BAM -> HDF5 pair store -> binned counts -> edgeR differential interactions
tools.notes: Only commit in window is the automated Bioconductor version bump (2026-04).

tools.name: diffxpy
tools.data_model: AnnData / numpy via batchglm
tools.notes: NB GLM Wald/LRT/t-test/Wilcoxon for single-cell; README says unmaintained and recommends PyDESeq2; repo archived 2025-10-21.

tools.name: EBSeq
tools.data_model: count matrix + size factors
tools.notes: Empirical-Bayes isoform/gene DE (RSEM's companion); MedianNorm size factors and PostFC posterior fold changes; Bioc version bumps only.

tools.name: edgePython
tools.data_model: DGEList-like Python objects

first_published.venue: bioRxiv (preprint cited in README; DOI not captured)

tools.notes: Pachter-lab Python port of edgeR (TMM, filter_by_expr, glm_ql_fit / glm_ql_ftest, NEBULA-LN) released 2026-10-22; too new to have docs site or journal paper.

tools.name: edgeR
tools.data_model: DGEList
tools.notes: TMM/RLE/upperquartile in calcNormFactors, cpm/logCPM, filterByExpr, QL F-test; catchSalmon/catchKallisto/catchRSEM read quant dirs (transcript-level, with overdispersion), featureCounts2DGEList and readDGE for count files; no tximport-style gene summarising.

tools.name: EnrichedHeatmap
tools.data_model: GRanges signal + targets -> normalizedMatrix -> ComplexHeatmap
tools.notes: normalizeToMatrix takes a GRanges with a value column (read bigWig via rtracklayer); heatmap lists concatenate tracks; GitHub push 2026-01.

tools.name: ensembldb
tools.data_model: EnsDb SQLite with Ensembl genes/transcripts/exons/proteins and filter framework
tools.notes: Ensembl-flavoured alternative to TxDb (ensDbFromGtf/ensDbFromGff, AnnotationHub EnsDb packages, tx support level / canonical filters, genome-transcript-protein coordinate mapping); used by Signac and ChIPpeakAnno.

tools.name: FAN-C
tools.data_model: end-to-end: pairs -> Hi-C objects; expected/o-e, loops (fanc loops), TADs, compartments, cool/.hic I/O
tools.notes: Last commit/release 2024-03.

tools.name: FAN-C (fancplot)
tools.data_model: FAN-C Hi-C objects (.hic/.cool/.juicer) + track files
tools.notes: fancplot CLI and fanc.plotting API: triangular/square Hi-C, bigWig line/bar panels, GTF gene panel, loop/TAD annotations; last commit 2024-03.

tools.name: fishpond (swish)
tools.data_model: SummarizedExperiment with inferential replicates (from tximeta)
tools.notes: Non-parametric DE (Wilcoxon / Mann-Whitney over salmon Gibbs/bootstrap replicates); scaleInfReps does median-ratio scaling, labelKeep filters; reads come via tximeta.

tools.name: FitHiChIP
tools.data_model: valid pairs (+ optional ChIP peaks) -> 1D peaks via MACS2, significant loops
tools.notes: PeakInferHiChIP.sh builds 1D coverage from HiC-Pro valid pairs (and DE/SC/RE reads when present) and calls peaks with MACS2; last commit 2024-04; v11 (2022-12) added .hic/.cool input; last commit 2024-04; no bioconda package found.

tools.name: GAT
tools.data_model: segments vs annotations sampled within a workspace (optionally isochore-stratified)
tools.notes: --num-threads, --workspace-file, --isochore-file; fold/l2fold/empirical p/q per annotation; unmaintained since 2019.

tools.name: geniml / BEDbase
tools.data_model: region-set embeddings (Region2Vec/BEDspace) with vector-index similarity search; BEDbase hosts the collection
tools.notes: Ranking is embedding similarity, not a statistical enrichment test; bedshift module provides perturbation nulls; geniml/BEDbase journal citation not found via Crossref (docs point to a how-to-cite page).

tools.name: genomation
tools.data_model: GRanges vs transcript features read from BED12 (readTranscriptFeatures) or GFF
tools.notes: annotateWithGeneParts / getAssociationWithTSS / plotTargetAnnotation working from BED12 gene models (no TxDb needed) plus ScoreMatrix heatmaps; maintenance-only since 2025-04; Last GitHub push 2025-04; the 2026-04 date is the Bioconductor 3.23 version bump.

tools.name: GenomeKit
tools.data_model: C++ binary genome/annotation/track files with lightweight Python Interval objects
tools.notes: Prebuilt GENCODE/RefSeq/Ensembl/MANE annotation binaries queried by interval (find_overlapping etc.), dna(), tracks, VCF/BAM access; capability flags for overlap/slop/parse_gtf from memory of the API, docs page did not enumerate them.

tools.name: GenomeSpy
tools.data_model: Vega-Lite-like JSON grammar, GPU rendering
tools.notes: Grammar-based, GPU-accelerated cohort/sample-faceted genome views (cancer genomics focus); embeds in any page; PNG export rather than figure-grade static output.

tools.name: GenometriCorr
tools.data_model: two interval sets; relative/absolute distance, Jaccard and projection tests with permutation
tools.notes: Version string from last commit message (2021-03), no tags; not on CRAN/Bioconductor.

tools.name: genomeview
tools.data_model: Document of Track objects rendered to SVG/PNG/PDF
tools.notes: Lightweight SVG renderer strong on BAM (short/long reads, quick consensus, grouping by tag); bigWig via pyBigWig, annotations as BED; dormant since 2023.

tools.name: Genomic HyperBrowser
tools.data_model: Galaxy-based track statistics with Monte-Carlo null models; GSuite collections
tools.notes: GSuite HyperBrowser (GigaScience 2017, 10.1093/gigascience/gix032) adds collection-level ranking; hyperbrowser.uio.no returned 503 on 2026-10-22; last commit 2023-09.

tools.name: GenomicDistributions
tools.data_model: GRanges vs reference TSS/partition sets (GenomicDistributionsData, TxDb/EnsDb)
tools.notes: QC-style summaries: calcFeatureDist (TSS distance), calcPartitions (promoterCore/Prox, exon, intron, UTRs, intergenic), chromosome bins, GC; plots for each; repo last pushed 2025-04; Adjacent: QC/characterisation of region sets, no enrichment test; last push 2025-04.

tools.name: GenomicFeatures + txdbmaker
tools.data_model: TxDb SQLite database of genes/transcripts/exons/CDS queried into GRanges/GRangesList
tools.notes: The gene-model substrate most R annotators depend on; makeTxDbFromGFF/UCSC/Ensembl/Biomart moved to txdbmaker in Bioc 3.19; genePred only via live UCSC table queries; BED12/GTF export through rtracklayer's asBED/asGFF.

tools.name: GenomicInteractions
tools.data_model: GInteractions from BEDPE/ChIA-PET/HOMER files; annotateInteractions (promoter/enhancer), export.igraph, Gviz InteractionTrack
tools.notes: Closest R analogue of a loop->graph workflow (export.igraph) but graph analysis is delegated to igraph; last GitHub commit 2022-04; Data structures underpinning diffHic/HiCExperiment; last GitHub commit 2025-07.

tools.name: GenomicRanges + IRanges
tools.data_model: S4 GRanges/IRanges: vectorised slots (seqnames Rle, IRanges start/width, strand Rle, DataFrame mcols)
tools.notes: The de-facto R standard; reading BED, liftOver and getSeq live in rtracklayer/BSgenome; GNCList() gives a reusable NCList index; parallelism via BiocParallel outside the package.

tools.name: GENOVA
tools.data_model: contacts objects from .hic/.cool/HiC-Pro/Juicer; APA/ATA, RCP, saddle, insulation
tools.notes: Loops consumed as BEDPE for APA; no caller; last commit 2024-03; GitHub install only; Hi-C analysis + pyramid/hic.matrixplot figures with loop/TAD overlays (APA, saddle, insulation); last commit 2024-03.

tools.name: GEO2R
tools.data_model: NCBI GEO series + NCBI-computed count matrices
tools.notes: NCBI web tool: limma for arrays, DESeq2 (beta) on NCBI-generated RNA-seq counts, exports the R script; help page is behind a captcha so details are from search snippets.

tools.name: gffpandas
tools.data_model: GFF3 -> pandas DataFrame (attributes_to_columns, filter_*, overlaps_with)
tools.notes: GFF3 only (no GTF), writes GFF3/CSV/TSV; dormant since 2019 release / 2024 push.

tools.name: gffread
tools.data_model: GFF/GTF transcript records with filtering, conversion and FASTA extraction
tools.notes: StringTie/Cufflinks companion: GFF<->GTF (-T), --bed BED12, -w/-x/-y sequence extraction, region filtering; no region annotation.

tools.name: gffutils
tools.data_model: GFF/GTF loaded into a SQLite FeatureDB with parent/child relations and UCSC-binned region queries
tools.notes: Hierarchical (children/parents) model with region() lookups, bed12() export, GFF<->GTF conversion and pybedtools integration; DB creation is the slow step.

tools.name: ggbio
tools.data_model: ggplot2 grammar over GRanges/TxDb/BamFile
tools.notes: autoplot() for GRanges/TxDb/BamFile, geom_arch links, tracks() stacking and circular layouts; maintenance mode, Bioc bumps.

tools.name: ggcoverage
tools.data_model: ggplot2 layers (geom_coverage, geom_gene, geom_link, geom_tad ...)
tools.notes: ggplot2 grammar for BAM/bigWig/bedGraph coverage + GTF genes + peaks + bedpe links + Hi-C matrix; removed from CRAN 2023-11, GitHub-only, last commit 2025-01.

tools.name: gghic

tools.name: ggseqlogo

tools.name: GIGGLE

tools.name: GimmeMotifs

tools.name: Gosling / gos

tools.notes: Generic graph engine; figshare DOI not Crossref-verifiable (DataCite); not on PyPI.

tools.notes: Last commit 2026-09.

tools.name: HiCExperiment / HiContacts

tools.name: HiCExplorer

tools.name: HiChIP-Peaks

tools.name: HiCHub
tools.data_model: bin-level network of differential interactions (.hic via straw) -> igraph communities = hubs; convert/diff/asso/plot

tools.name: HiCPlotter
tools.data_model: dense Hi-C matrices + bedGraph/bed tracks
tools.notes: Python 2.7 script for side-by-side Hi-C heatmaps with bedGraph/bed/arc tracks; last commit 2020-07, no releases.

tools.name: HiCseg

tools.notes: Adjacent (TADs); removed from CRAN and archived 2024-03-24.

tools.name: hicstuff

tools.name: HiGlass

tools.name: HOMER

tools.name: HTSeq
tools.data_model: GenomicArray / per-sample count files

tools.name: HTSeq GenomicArray
tools.data_model: GenomicArray / GenomicArrayOfSets step vectors (ndarray, step or memmap storage)
tools.notes: Interval-indexed arrays for counting/coverage (htseq-count) plus a streaming GFF_Reader; feature classes must be built by the user; HTSeq 2.0 paper 2022 (btac166).

tools.name: Hub-enhancer / enhancer-community analyses (method only)

tools.data_model: custom scripts: Hi-C/capture-C contacts among (super-)enhancers -> network degree/community -> hub or community calls

tools.name: iced

tools.name: IGD

tools.name: igraph

tools.name: IGV desktop

tools.name: igv-notebook

tools.name: igv-reports

tools.name: igv.js
tools.data_model: JSON browser config / session

tools.name: imPROSE

tools.name: Intervene

tools.name: LILY

tools.name: limma

tools.name: LocusZoom
tools.data_model: GWAS association + LD + gene panel
tools.notes: Adjacent (variant association plots with a gene track); LocusZoom.js 2021 Bioinformatics 10.1093/bioinformatics/btab186; R port locuszoomr on CRAN makes static ggplot versions; JS commits to 2025-05.

tools.notes: bedtools-like for loops; not on PyPI/bioconda (404 on both); last commit 2022-11.

tools.name: plotgardener
tools.data_model: coordinate-based multi-panel genomic figures: Hi-C squares/triangles from .hic (strawr), BEDPE arches/pairs, signals, genes
tools.notes: Viewer used by the OHCA/HiContacts stack for arcs; GitHub activity not checked; Sushi's successor: absolute-coordinate multi-panel pages (plotHicTriangle/Square, plotPairsArches, plotSignal, plotGenes from TxDb/OrgDb) for publication figures.

tools.name: plyranges
tools.data_model: dplyr-style verbs over GRanges
tools.notes: Grammar (join_overlap_*, join_nearest, reduce_ranges, stretch/anchor, tile_ranges, compute_coverage) on top of GenomicRanges; now maintained under tidyomics.

tools.name: polars-bio
tools.data_model: Polars/Arrow DataFrames over an Apache DataFusion (Rust) engine; COITrees for overlaps
tools.notes: overlap/nearest/count_overlaps/coverage/merge/cluster/complement/subtract with lazy scans, streaming sinks and cloud (S3/GCS) reads; readers for BED/GFF3/GTF/VCF/BAM/FASTQ etc.; no union/liftover.

tools.name: poverlap
tools.data_model: two BED files; bedtools-shuffle null with include/exclude and local shuffling
tools.notes: No paper; the PyPI package named 'poverlap' is an unrelated 2D-geometry package; last commit 2020-07.

tools.name: profileplyr
tools.data_model: profileplyr object (RangedSummarizedExperiment of region x bin matrices)
tools.notes: Imports deepTools computeMatrix output or builds matrices via soGGi, plots with EnrichedHeatmap; range annotation and grouping.

tools.name: Pscan
tools.data_model: promoter or peak set + JASPAR/TRANSFAC library -> over-represented matrices vs genome background
tools.notes: HTTP-only server at 159.149.160.88/pscan; unreachable over HTTPS on 2026-10-22, status unverified.

tools.name: PWMEnrich
tools.data_model: PWM list + lognormal background -> affinity scores and enrichment reports
tools.notes: Threshold-free lognormal affinity model with precomputed genome backgrounds; motifDiffEnrichment for two sets; activity is the Bioconductor bump only.

tools.name: PWMScan
tools.data_model: PWM (JASPAR/TRANSFAC/PFM/LPM/SSA) -> genome-wide matches via Bowtie or matrix_scan
tools.notes: Web server moved to epd.expasy.org/pwmtools ('last update April 2021'); score<->p-value conversion with background models; standalone C package not verified.

tools.name: pybedlite
tools.data_model: BedRecord dataclasses + OverlapDetector (interval tree per refname)
tools.notes: Deliberately lightweight BED read/write + overlap detection for pipelines; no arithmetic beyond overlaps.

tools.name: pybedtools
tools.data_model: BedTool wrapper around bedtools subprocesses + Cython Interval/IntervalFile objects
tools.notes: Requires the bedtools binary; IntervalFile.all_hits gives an in-memory index; to_dataframe/from_dataframe for pandas; pybedtools.parallel for multi-process shuffles.

tools.name: pybigtools
tools.data_model: BBIReader/Writer objects; CLI bigwigaverageoverbed, bedgraphtobigwig, bigwigmerge
tools.notes: Rust reimplementation of UCSC kent bigWig/bigBed I/O with multithreaded writing; average_over_bed in the Python API.

tools.name: pyBigWig
tools.data_model: bigWig file handle -> numpy arrays / stats
tools.notes: Low-level reader/writer used by deepTools; remote http access; threaded calls serialise on the GIL.

tools.name: pycistarget
tools.data_model: precomputed cisTarget ranking/score databases -> NES enrichment and differentially enriched motifs
tools.notes: Not on PyPI (pip from GitHub, Rust extension); last commit 2026-10-22; databases built separately with Cluster-Buster.

tools.name: PyDESeq2
tools.data_model: DeseqDataSet (AnnData subclass)
tools.notes: Pure-Python DESeq2 (Wald test, multi-factor designs via formulaic, apeglm-style lfc_shrink); takes a pandas/AnnData count matrix, no quantifier readers; Python >=3.11.

tools.name: pyensembl
tools.data_model: Ensembl release GTF+FASTA downloaded and indexed into SQLite; Gene/Transcript/Exon objects
tools.notes: Locus/ID/name lookups (genes_at_locus etc.) and sequences for Ensembl releases or custom GTF/FASTA; overlap lookups only, no nearest or feature classes.

tools.name: pyfaidx
tools.data_model: indexed FASTA (dict-like)
tools.notes: Random access to FASTA by .fai index; its `faidx` CLI extracts BED regions (bedtools getfasta's library-side counterpart).

tools.name: pyGenomeTracks
tools.data_model: track-file renderer: Hi-C matrices (cool/h5), arcs/links from BEDPE-like files, BED/bigWig
tools.notes: Viewer; last commit 2026-08; De-facto standard static track figure (bigwig, bedgraph, GTF/bed12 genes, links arcs, cool/h5 Hi-C triangles, TADs); no BAM track; last PyPI release 2024-07 but commits to 2026-08.

tools.name: pyGenomeViz
tools.data_model: genome feature tracks + synteny links (GenBank/GFF)
tools.notes: Prokaryote / comparative-genomics feature maps with synteny links (MUMmer/BLAST), HTML export and a Streamlit app; not an NGS signal-track viewer.

tools.name: pygtftk
tools.data_model: C-backed GTF object exposed through ~100 gtftk subcommands and a Python API
tools.notes: get_5p_3p_coords/tss_dist/closest_genes/intronic/get_tx_seq/convert plus OLOGRAM overlap-enrichment statistics; PyPI release 2022 but repo pushed 2026-01; Travis badge stale.

tools.name: pyJASPAR
tools.data_model: SQLite snapshot of JASPAR releases -> Bio.motifs.jaspar.Motif objects
tools.notes: Offline JASPAR access (through JASPAR 2024/2026 releases); scanning is left to Biopython.

tools.name: pymemesuite
tools.data_model: Cython bindings to MEME's FIMO over MotifFile / Sequence objects
tools.license: MIT (bindings; MEME code under its own licence)
tools.notes: Alpha-stage in-process FIMO; GitHub activity after 2025-05 not checked.

tools.name: pyranges
tools.data_model: in-memory GenomicRanges-like DataFrames; stats module (fisher_exact, jaccard, relative distance, MCC)
tools.notes: Engine with per-pair statistics only; pyranges v0 line (0.1.x) still released 2026-10 alongside pyranges 1.x.

tools.name: pyranges (0.x)
tools.data_model: dict of per-(chrom,strand) pandas DataFrames; NCLS built per call
tools.notes: Legacy line still released (0.1.6, 2026-10) but README says v1 'will soon replace' it; nb_cpu multiprocessing via ray; stats module (jaccard/forbes/fisher); features.tss()/tes()/introns() from GTF.

tools.name: pyranges (1.x)
tools.data_model: PyRanges subclass of pandas DataFrame with a Rust backend
tools.notes: Complete rewrite published as package 'pyranges1' (requires Python>=3.12); set_num_threads for the Rust engine; read_chain exists but liftover not verified; also a 'pyranger' CLI; preprint DOI copied verbatim from the README.

tools.name: pysam
tools.data_model: AlignmentFile -> reads, pileup columns, count_coverage arrays
tools.notes: The Python BAM layer: count_coverage gives per-base ACGT counts in memory; no bigWig.

tools.name: pytximport
tools.data_model: xarray Dataset / AnnData / SummarizedExperiment
tools.notes: Python tximport (salmon, kallisto, RSEM, piscem/oarfish, generic tsv) with CLI and library; outputs AnnData or BiocPy SummarizedExperiment; helpers to build tx2gene maps.

tools.name: QuIN
tools.data_model: ChIA-PET/Hi-C interactions -> chromatin interaction network; query by regions, annotate, rank nodes by network measures
tools.notes: Earliest dedicated contact-network hub tool; quin.jax.org refused connections 2026-10-22; last commit 2020-12.

tools.name: RcisTarget
tools.data_model: precomputed motif rankings (feather) -> AUC/NES enrichment per gene/region set
tools.notes: Deprecated in Bioconductor 3.23 (removal planned for 3.24); superseded by pycistarget; no scanning, relies on precomputed cisTarget databases.

tools.name: regioneR
tools.data_model: GRanges pairs, permutation test with pluggable randomisation/evaluation
tools.notes: Circular/random/resample-from-universe permutation tests for one pair of region sets; mc.cores parallelism; last GitHub commit 2025-05.

tools.name: regioneReloaded
tools.data_model: multi-set crosswise permutation matrices (regioneR extension)
tools.notes: crosswisePermTest: z-score association matrix across many region sets with clustering/plots; last commit 2023-06.

tools.name: RegRegSEA
tools.data_model: GSEA-style scoring of a ranked list of differential regions against UniBind/LOLA/JASPAR region sets
tools.notes: Saarland CCB web server; citation on site is a 2026 placeholder (unpublished); GitHub link is an issue tracker only.

tools.name: RELI
tools.data_model: variant set (+LD) vs library of ChIP-seq peak sets; simulation-based null
tools.notes: SNP/GWAS-centric: null draws from background variant sets with LD expansion; last commit 2026-06 (README).

tools.name: ReMapEnrich
tools.data_model: GRanges query vs ReMap (or user) peak catalogue; shuffling-based enrichment
tools.notes: Introduced with ReMap 2018 (issued online 2017); shuffles query against catalogue with optional universe; README mentions 'single core' default; last commit 2021-11; install via devtools only.

tools.name: rGenomeTracks
tools.data_model: R track objects translated to pyGenomeTracks INI
tools.notes: R wrapper around pyGenomeTracks (needs the Python tool installed); inherits its track set and single-region output.

tools.name: rGREAT
tools.data_model: regulatory domains built from TSS (TxDb/GRanges/built-in GENCODE) + gene sets; local or online GREAT
tools.notes: Local GREAT (binomial over basal+extension domains) for any organism/gene-set plus the web-service client; plotRegionGeneAssociations gives distance-to-TSS plots; Shiny viewer; Adjacent (annotation theme): functional enrichment of one region set; last commit 2026-01.

tools.name: RNAlysis
tools.data_model: CountFilter tables (pandas) with GUI pipelines
tools.notes: GUI-first (no-code) with a Python API; TMM / median-of-ratios / RPM normalisation and low-read filters native, DESeq2 and limma-voom run through an R installation.

tools.name: RNAnorm
tools.data_model: scikit-learn style transformers on pandas matrices
tools.notes: CPM, FPKM, TPM, UQ, CUF, TMM, CTF as sklearn transformers plus a CLI; normalisation only, last commit 2025-04.

tools.name: ROSE
tools.aka: ROSE (stjude Python 3 port of the Young-lab Rank Ordering of Super-Enhancers)
tools.data_model: peaks GFF + BAM -> stitched regions, ranked signal, SE calls
tools.notes: Stitching (12.5 kb) + TSS exclusion + input-subtracted rpm ranking + tangent-line knee; GitHub push 2025-11; Docker image provided; original Young-lab code was Python 2; Adjacent: SE calling only; stjude mirror of the Young-lab Bitbucket code (README commit 2025-11), Python 2 era.

tools.name: ROSE2
tools.data_model: peaks + BAM (via bamliquidator) -> stitched, ranked SE table
tools.notes: Requires bamliquidator; last commit 2019-10; licence not stated on PyPI or GitHub.

tools.name: RSAT
tools.aka: Regulatory Sequence Analysis Tools: matrix-scan, matrix-clustering, compare-matrices, peak-motifs, convert-matrix
tools.data_model: TRANSFAC-like matrix files; per-tool tab outputs; web servers per taxon
tools.notes: matrix-clustering is the engine behind JASPAR's motif clusters; Markov background models for p-values; 2022 update NAR 10.1093/nar/gkac312.

tools.name: Rsubread featureCounts
tools.data_model: count matrix over GTF features
tools.notes: Adjacent counting step (produces the featureCounts tables); Rsubread paper 10.1093/nar/gkz114; nthreads.

tools.name: rtracklayer
tools.data_model: import/export of BED/GFF/GTF/bigWig/bigBed/chain into GRanges
tools.notes: The I/O layer of Bioconductor: import(GTF/GFF/BED), export.bed (BED12 via asBED), export.gff, liftOver(chain), indexed 'which=' queries on bigWig/tabix; no arithmetic of its own; The R bigWig I/O layer every Bioconductor profile package builds on; summary() gives per-region means.

tools.name: RUVSeq
tools.data_model: SeqExpressionSet
tools.notes: Removes unwanted variation (RUVg/RUVs/RUVr) as covariates for edgeR/DESeq2; upstream GitHub last commit 2022-11, Bioc bumps only.

tools.name: samtools
tools.data_model: BAM/CRAM -> per-base depth / pileup text
tools.notes: mpileup is the canonical per-base allele/base-count tool; no bigWig support.

tools.name: scanpy
tools.data_model: AnnData
tools.notes: Adjacent (single-cell): normalize_total/log1p is CPM-like, rank_genes_groups is t-test/Wilcoxon/logreg rather than NB GLM, sc.pp.combat for batch.

tools.name: SciPy (csgraph)
tools.data_model: sparse adjacency matrix
tools.notes: connected_components and sparse linear algebra on an adjacency matrix: genomeblocks' pip-default graph backend.

tools.name: SEanalysis 2.0
tools.data_model: user regions / genes / TFs queried against SEdb super-enhancer sets
tools.notes: Annotates user regions against precomputed ROSE-called SEs from SEdb (2.0 paper NAR 2023, PMC10320134); does not call SEs from user signal.

tools.name: seqLogo
tools.data_model: PWM -> grid logo
tools.notes: Oldest Bioconductor logo package (since BioC 2.0); activity is the Bioconductor bump only.

tools.name: seqplots
tools.data_model: bigWig tracks + feature BEDs -> PlotSetArray (Shiny GUI or R API)
tools.notes: Removed from Bioconductor; last commit 2022-05; also plots motif-density tracks alongside signal.

tools.name: Signac
tools.data_model: Seurat ChromatinAssay with an EnsDb-derived annotation GRanges
tools.notes: Single-cell framework; peak annotation = ClosestFeature (nearest annotation feature with type exon/cds/utr/gap, deprecated in 1.17.0), GetTSSPositions, LinkPeaks; gene models come from ensembldb EnsDb; FindMotifs: hypergeometric test against GC-matched background peaks; JASPAR via TFBSTools getMatrixSet.

tools.name: sleuth
tools.data_model: sleuth object over kallisto bootstraps
tools.notes: Reads kallisto HDF5 bootstraps (salmon via wasabi), gene_mode aggregation, measurement-error model with Wald/LRT and a Shiny explorer; GitHub-only R package, last commit 2025-05.

tools.name: SnapATAC2
tools.data_model: AnnData cell x peak + PyDNAMotif (cisBP/JASPAR bundles) -> per-group enrichment tables
tools.notes: Rust-backed single-cell framework; hypergeometric (no background) or binomial (with background) motif enrichment over region groups.

tools.name: soGGi
tools.data_model: ChIPprofile (RangedSummarizedExperiment) from BAM/bigWig
tools.notes: Deprecated and removed from Bioconductor 3.23; last version in 3.22; backend of profileplyr.

tools.name: STAMP
tools.data_model: uploaded matrices -> alignment, DB matching, multiple alignment and tree
tools.notes: Server still answers (2026-10-22) but its databases stop at JASPAR 2010 / TRANSFAC 11.3.

tools.name: straw
tools.data_model: random-access reader for .hic (observed / oe, KR/VC/SCALE)
tools.notes: No standalone paper (described with Juicebox); C++/Python/R/Java/JS bindings; last commit 2025-04.

tools.name: SummarizedExperiment
tools.data_model: assays x rowRanges x colData container

first_published.venue: Nature Methods (Orchestrating high-throughput genomic analysis with Bioconductor)

tools.notes: The container every Bioconductor DE tool consumes; rowRanges aligns assays to gene models, which is the design genomeblocks' gene-row expression table mirrors.

tools.name: superintervals
tools.data_model: superset-index over sorted interval arrays (C++ header-only, Rust crate, Python ext)
tools.notes: Single-chromosome interval index with SIMD counting; merge_overlaps/union/intersection/difference/symmetric_difference/gaps/span; R binding in a separate repo; README-level docs only.

tools.name: Sushi
tools.data_model: data.frame-based base-graphics track functions
tools.notes: Deprecated (README points to plotgardener); removed from Bioconductor after release 3.14; plotBedpe arcs / plotHic from data.frames, bedGraph not bigWig.

tools.name: sva / ComBat-seq
tools.data_model: count or expression matrix + batch vector

first_published.venue: Bioinformatics (sva); ComBat-seq 2020 NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics 10.1093/nargab/lqaa078

tools.notes: Surrogate variable analysis, ComBat and ComBat-seq (NB batch adjustment on counts); the reference implementation that InMoose ports.

tools.name: svist4get
tools.data_model: config-file driven PDF/PNG of a locus
tools.notes: Publication-style locus images from bedGraph tracks + GTF + FASTA (sequence shown at base resolution); last commit 2024-07.

tools.name: tabix / htslib
tools.data_model: bgzip-compressed sorted text + on-disk .tbi/.csi binning index
tools.notes: Random-access region index, not an arithmetic toolkit; faidx sequence fetch is the same library; used by pysam, bedr, giggle.

tools.name: tangermeme
tools.data_model: PyTorch tensors of one-hot sequences / attributions; seqlets annotated via Tomtom
tools.notes: Deep-learning interpretation toolkit (adjacent); FIMO/Tomtom CLI moved to memesuite-lite, so scanning keys left null; preprint bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.08.08.669296.

tools.name: TF-COMB
tools.data_model: TF x TF co-occurrence within windows via market-basket analysis; distance/orientation/network follow-ups
tools.notes: Pairwise co-occupancy of TFBS/peaks (not query-vs-collection); last commit/release 2025-06.

tools.name: TF-MoDISco-lite
tools.data_model: one-hot sequences + attribution scores -> seqlets -> patterns (h5) + Tomtom report
tools.notes: Adjacent: de novo motifs from deep-learning attributions, not from sequence sets; arXiv DOI follows the standard arXiv DOI scheme.

tools.name: TFBSTools
tools.data_model: PFMatrix/PWMatrix classes, JASPAR DB access, searchSeq SiteSets
tools.notes: Matrix classes used across Bioconductor; searchSeq thresholds are relative scores (min.score), de novo only via the runMEME wrapper.

tools.name: TFEA.ChIP
tools.data_model: gene list vs ChIP-seq-derived TF-gene association DB (ReMap/GeneHancer); Fisher and GSEA-style
tools.notes: Adjacent: input is a gene list (e.g. DE genes), regions enter only via the prebuilt TF-gene DB; last commit 2025-07.

tools.name: TOBIAS
tools.aka: ATACorrect / ScoreBigwig / PlotAggregate / PlotHeatmap / TFBScan / BINDetect / ClusterMotifs
tools.data_model: BAM -> bias-corrected bigWig -> footprint scores; motifs -> TFBS BED
tools.notes: ATAC footprinting suite; TFBScan uses MOODS with p-value thresholds, BINDetect compares conditions, ClusterMotifs builds motif similarity clusters.

tools.name: trackc
tools.data_model: matplotlib Axes-based tracks (Hi-C, Virtual4C, loops, bigWig, bed, genes)
tools.notes: Newer matplotlib-native 3D-genome track plotter aimed at rearranged genomes (multi-region/zoom-in layouts, Virtual4C); 0.0.x versions, no paper found.

tools.name: trackplot
tools.data_model: bigWig (via bwtool) -> track / profile / heatmap data.tables
tools.notes: Minimal-dependency R script layered on bwtool; IGV-style locus plots plus profiles/heatmaps; GitHub push 2024-10; DOI inferred from the article id vbae031; Minimal-dependency IGV-style locus plots, profile plots and heatmaps from bigWig (needs bwtool); gene models from UCSC/GTF; last commit 2024-10, no tagged releases. Distinct from the Python sashimi tool of the same name.

tools.name: tracktables
tools.data_model: sample sheet -> IGV session XML + HTML report
tools.notes: Builds IGV sessions and HTML region tables that open loci in a running IGV; export-to-IGV helper rather than a renderer.

tools.name: trackViewer
tools.data_model: track S4 objects + GInteractions
tools.notes: Lollipop/dandelion plots, interaction heatmaps and loopBouquetPlot (a 3D-ish contact-network layout), browseTracks htmlwidget for interactive HTML.

tools.name: tximeta
tools.data_model: SummarizedExperiment with rowRanges from matched transcriptome
tools.notes: tximport + automatic transcriptome identification by index checksum; attaches GRanges/TxDb gene models and summarizeToGene(); the closest R analogue of GTF-aligned expression tables.

tools.name: tximport
tools.data_model: list of count/abundance/length matrices
tools.notes: Reference implementation of lengthScaledTPM / scaledTPM transcript-to-gene summarising; quantifier type must be given explicitly (type=); also reads sailfish/StringTie/alevin.

tools.name: UCSC Genome Browser
tools.data_model: track hubs / custom tracks / sessions over bigWig, BAM, bigBed, .hic
tools.license: mixed (free for academic / non-commercial; kent source has mixed terms)
tools.notes: Reference web browser: PDF/SVG view export, interact/bigInteract arcs, .hic tracks, multi-region mode, REST API and track hubs; kent repo commits to 2026-10 (no tagged releases).

tools.name: UCSC kent utilities
tools.data_model: one file-to-file command per operation
tools.notes: Reference implementation of the bigWig format; one-region-one-number tools, no matrices or plots.

tools.name: UniBind Enrichment
tools.data_model: LOLA-precomputed UniBind TFBS region DBs; one-set-vs-background, differential, or no-background modes
tools.notes: unibind.uio.no/enrichment up on 2026-10-22; CLI version on Bitbucket (activity not checked); LOLA DBs on Zenodo (2020-11).

tools.name: universalmotif
tools.data_model: universalmotif class with converters to/from every major motif format
tools.notes: Import/export of JASPAR, MEME, TRANSFAC, HOMER, CIS-BP, UniPROBE; scan_sequences with p-value thresholds, enrich_motifs vs shuffled/background, compare_motifs + motif trees; de novo only via run_meme wrapper.

tools.name: UROPA
tools.data_model: JSON query config (feature, feature.anchor start/center/end, distance, strand, filters, priority) over GTF + BED
tools.notes: Any GTF feature type with user anchors/distances and prioritised multi-query annotation (allhits/finalhits/besthits TSV + summary PDF); last release 2023, repo last pushed 2023-12.

tools.name: valr
tools.data_model: tibbles (chrom/start/end) with cpp11 interval kernels
tools.notes: bedtools semantics in the tidyverse (bed_intersect/closest/merge/slop/makewindows/jaccard/fisher/projection); create_tss/create_introns/create_utrs from BED12; read_gtf is deprecated.

tools.name: Vierstra motif archetypes
tools.data_model: clustered motif models -> archetypes + genome-wide hg38/mm10 scan BEDs
tools.notes: Resource/notebook workflow rather than a package: Tomtom-similarity clustering of CIS-BP + JASPAR2022 (5193 models -> 693 clusters) and precomputed MOODS scans; last commit 2023-04.

tools.name: WashU Epigenome Browser
tools.data_model: datahub JSON of tracks
tools.notes: Rewritten 3rd-generation codebase (eg3, 2025 NAR update); longrange/bedpe arcs, .hic/cool heatmaps, gene-set multi-region view, SVG screenshots; no tagged releases, commits to 2026-08.

tools.name: WiggleTools
tools.data_model: lazy numeric-function algebra over bigWig/BAM/bedGraph/wig streams
tools.notes: mean/sum/scale across tracks, apply over BED regions, profile command (numbers only); last commit 2026-05.

tools.name: Wilcoxon rank-sum DE (Li et al. 2022)
tools.data_model: recipe: edgeR TMM-normalised CPM + wilcox.test per gene
tools.notes: A method recommendation (Wilcoxon beats DESeq2/edgeR FDR control at large n), not a package; include only as a benchmark baseline row.

tools.name: GenomicAlignments
tools.data_model: GAlignments (S4) from BAM
tools.notes: Reads BAM alignments into R; summarizeOverlaps counts reads per feature (Union / IntersectStrict / IntersectNotEmpty modes). Added 2026-10-23 as an engine the landscape benchmark runs.

tools.name: pychromVAR
tools.data_model: AnnData / MuData (peaks x cells)
tools.notes: Python port of chromVAR (GC-matched background peaks, motif deviation z-scores). Added 2026-10-23 as an engine the landscape benchmark runs.
